hook: Planted Docker keys were stolen in 8 seconds — plus 4 more

items.claim: Researchers' planted Docker Hub AWS keys were first used 7.86 seconds after publishing; median 51 seconds.
Java4Shell flaw lets unauthenticated attackers run code on Jenkins, Jira, Confluence and others; patched.
Google Search adds answers with tables and images using Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
Gemini app now runs on lower-memory Android phones; Gemini Live supports more than 45 languages.
Microsoft outage disrupted Outlook and Teams for companies and governments worldwide.

caption: From stolen cloud keys to a worldwide Outlook and Teams outage, this week’s tech news spans security, AI, and outages. Stay ahead of the risks and upgrades that affect your daily tools. Which breach scared you more, the Docker key theft or the Java flaw?
alt_text: Five slides on flat colour backgrounds list: planted Docker keys first used 7.86 seconds after publishing, Java4Shell lets unauthenticated attackers run code on Jenkins, Jira and Confluence, Google Search adds answers with tables and images using Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini app runs on lower-memory Android phones and Gemini Live supports more than 45 languages, Microsoft outage disrupts Outlook and Teams worldwide.

es.hook: Las llaves Docker plantadas fueron robadas en 8 segundos — y 4 más
items: Llaves Docker Hub de AWS plantadas por los investigadores: se usaron por primera vez 7,86 segundos después de su publicación; la mediana fue de 51 segundos.
Vulnerabilidad Java4Shell: permite que atacantes no autenticados ejecuten código en Jenkins, Jira, Confluence y otros; ya está parcheada.
Google Search: añade respuestas con tablas e imágenes usando Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
Aplicación Gemini: ahora funciona en teléfonos Android con menos memoria; Gemini Live admite más de 45 idiomas.
Corte de Microsoft: interrumpió Outlook y Teams para empresas y gobiernos de todo el mundo.
